test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A metallic cone of radius 12 cm and height 36 cm is melted and made into spheres of radius 3 cm each. How many spheres are there?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of cone (r) = 12 cm

Height of cone (h) = 36 cm

Radius of each sphere (R) = 3 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × R³

**Calculation:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × 12² × 36

⇒ Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × 144 × 36 = 1728π cm³

Volume of one sphere = (4/3) × π × 3³

⇒ Volume of one sphere = (4/3) × π × 27 = 36π cm³

Number of spheres = Volume of cone / Volume of one sphere

⇒ Number of spheres = 1728π / 36π = 48

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
